name: Eastern Michigan Industries
old_description: Eastern Michigan Industries was started in 2000.  We started with the desire to produce hugh quality fabrications for the tooling industry.  Our mission is quality to always be considdered over timing.  It is our desire to fulfill your companys needs with the best combination between Cost, Timing and Quality!!  We are however human and if mistakes are made rest assured that we will do what ever it takes to fix the problem and make it right!
about:
Eastern Michigan Industries was founded in 2000 in Warren, Michigan. The company began with the goal of producing high-quality fabrications for the tooling industry.

The shop operates from two locations totaling more than 45,000 square feet with approximately 25 employees. It offers full-service fabricating with weight capacities up to 50,000 pounds, plate burning up to 12 inches thick, high-definition plasma cutting up to 108 by 520 inches, Blanchard grinding up to 156 inches, and large-format machining up to 144 by 672 inches. Services also include MIG and TIG welding of stainless steel and aluminum, AWS-certified welding inspection, and ASNT Level II nondestructive testing.

Customers span military, automotive, aircraft, marine, residential, and wastewater-treatment sectors. Typical projects include heavy machine bases, robot risers, tubular frames, structural stairways and platforms, and certified aircraft and marine fabrications.

The company states that its mission is to prioritize quality over timing and to correct any mistakes promptly, emphasizing a combination of cost, timing, and quality.

name: Eastman Screen Printing
old_description: Founded in 2022, Eastman Screen Printing was a dream long in the making…
about:
Founded in 2022, Eastman Screen Printing opened in Concord, New Hampshire, as a locally owned shop. Managers Ron Dulong and Sam Mostue describe the venture as a long-held dream to bring a transparent, in-house screen printing service to the community, where customers can watch the work being done.

The company provides screen printing on apparel and tote bags using plastisol, water-based, and discharge inks; embroidery with digitizing, 3D foam, and puff styles; signs, banners, and vehicle graphics printed on weather-safe vinyl; and business printing including cards, brochures, flyers, and direct-mail services such as Every Door Direct Mail. Orders range from one piece to over 10,000, all produced in-house with rush capabilities.

Eastman serves local businesses, schools, and organizations throughout Concord and central New Hampshire. Clients have included a tree-care company, a school theatre program, and corporate customers needing branded uniforms and promotional gear.

The shop emphasizes in-house production for speed, quality, and control; full-service support from design preparation through delivery; personalized service with transparent pricing; and a commitment to the Concord community.

name: Eaton Sales & Service LLC
old_description: Excellent service and a wide surplus of inventory. Attention to every detail. It’s no wonder they’ve been in business since 1919.
about:
Eaton Sales & Service LLC traces its origins to 1919 in Casper, Wyoming. The business evolved from Eaton Metal Products Company, which was active in petroleum equipment during the 1950s before financial pressures in the 1960s shifted its focus to tank and steel fabrication. In the early 1980s, the company re-entered the petroleum equipment market through a series of acquisitions and internal growth, formally adopting the Eaton Sales & Service LLC name by the mid-1990s.

Today the company manufactures above-ground and underground fuel storage tanks and provides full-spectrum petroleum equipment sales, installation, and service across nine locations in Colorado, Utah, Wyoming, New Mexico, and Arizona. Its capabilities span fueling system construction, lubrication equipment service, mechanical integrity inspection, and distribution. The firm maintains a team of factory- and regulatory-certified technicians trained on brands such as Wayne, Veeder Root, OPW, Franklin, Verifone, Rotary, Graco, and Champion, and reports more than 500,000 completed projects and 30,000 active customers.

Eaton serves retail and commercial fueling stations, agricultural operations, marinas, and aviation facilities. Its customer base includes major oil companies, big-box retailers, grocery chains, and independent fueling operators throughout the Rocky Mountain region.

The company states its mission is to anticipate and exceed customer expectations with responsive, cost-effective manufacturing, construction, and service. It emphasizes safety, quality, and innovation, citing unmatched buying power from century-long manufacturer relationships and an engineering team that supports its tank designs.

name: Eckhart Woodworking
old_description: Welcome to Eckhart, where tradition meets innovation in the world of custom woodworking. As a family-owned business, we take pride in our heritage of exquisite craftsmanship and Amish construction expertise. Specializing in custom molding, restorations, interior and exterior doors, gun cabinets, restaurant and bar interiors, custom live edge conference room tables, merchant display units as well as cutting-edge CNC work, we bring a touch of timeless artistry to every project.
about:
Eckhart Woodworking is a family-owned custom woodworking shop based in Monroe, Indiana, founded in 1989. The company began with a heritage of Amish construction expertise and has remained family-operated for over three decades.

The shop specializes in custom molding (offering 1,200 profile styles), interior and exterior doors, gun cabinets, restaurant and bar interiors, live-edge conference tables, merchant display units, and modern design furniture. It also provides precision CNC machining services for intricate detailing. Capabilities range from restoration trim matching to full custom furniture production.

Eckhart serves residential homeowners, commercial contractors, hospitality businesses, retail fixture buyers, and institutional clients such as offices needing conference tables. Past projects include custom entry doors for homes, bar and restaurant build-outs, and merchant display units for retail spaces.

The company emphasizes a second-chance employment mission, providing opportunities to individuals who have struggled in the past. It also highlights heritage craftsmanship, close client collaboration, premium wood sourcing, and on-time delivery as key differentiators.

about:
Eco Woodworks operates from Tumwater, Washington, serving the greater Olympia area. The shop has been in business for over two decades, specializing in custom carpentry and historical restoration. Ownership structure and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides a range of woodworking services including historic preservation following Secretary of Interior Federal Guidelines, wood window restoration and new window manufacturing with weatherization, custom and semi-custom cabinets and furniture, door fabrication, finish carpentry remodeling, and handcrafted mantels and millwork. All pieces are built in their own shop.

Eco Woodworks primarily serves residential customers and historic property owners in the Olympia region. Their portfolio includes work on historic sites and homes, with an emphasis on preserving architectural integrity. They also collaborate with local partners for community outreach and education.

The shop differentiates itself through a sustainability-first approach, integrating preservation practices throughout the project lifecycle. They emphasize energy-efficient weatherization for windows without altering historic aesthetics, and maintain a culture of community engagement through local partnerships.

name: EcoGen America
old_description: Founded in 2016, we have expanded from regional roots to a nationwide data-driven platform, accumulating nearly a decade of direct solar industry exposure.
about:
EcoGen America is based in Camden, Delaware, and was founded in 2016 by Trevor Guilday to connect homeowners with local solar installers. The company expanded nationwide in 2022 to cover all 50 states, Washington, D.C., and Puerto Rico, and rebuilt its platform in 2025 with a homeowner-first brand and stricter verification frameworks. Chief Executive Officer Dean Mahmoud, who has worked in residential solar since 2021, leads the business alongside Guilday, who maintains the company's Solar Cost Index.

The firm operates an independent solar education platform that publishes state-level cost benchmarks, incentive explanations, and savings calculators. Its proprietary EcoGen Solar Database combines government and laboratory data — including benchmarks from the Department of Energy's National Laboratory of the Rockies, wage data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics, and electricity-use figures from the Energy Information Administration — with a calibrated cost model and marketplace quote data. As of September 2026, the platform listed six verified installer partners and had processed more than 25,000 quote requests.

EcoGen serves residential homeowners across the United States who are evaluating solar installations. The service is free to users; the company earns referral fees from partner installers but states that compensation does not influence editorial content. Installers that pass three published checks — an active state license, documented installations in the state, and a workmanship warranty covering roof penetrations — receive an EcoGen Verified Installer badge.

The platform was created to address a transparency gap in the solar industry, where homeowners faced high-pressure sales tactics without reliable data. The company emphasizes editorial independence, public data sourcing, and partner accountability through complaint review and TCPA compliance agreements.

name: Ecotex – Healthcare Laundry Services, New Mexico
old_description: Ecotex is a privately owned, family-led company that has been delivering laundry services people count on since 1959. Built over three generations of the Bartsch family, we are a multi-generational family enterprise focused on creating and maintaining productive long-term partnerships with large healthcare customers.
about:
Ecotex, headquartered in Albuquerque, New Mexico, traces its roots to 1959 when Eldon and Ruth Bartsch opened Southgate Cleaners, a small local cleaning service. The privately owned, family-led business has since passed through three generations of the Bartsch family, with Bryan Bartsch now serving as president and chief executive officer.

Today the company operates multiple regional laundry facilities, including the largest healthcare laundry plant in North America, and employs more than 1,700 people. Its core service is hygienically clean linen processing for hospitals and long-term care facilities, handling over one million pieces daily. Ecotex provides reusable textiles such as patient gowns, bedding, surgical linens, scrubs, and PPE, along with product distribution and on-site linen management staff. The plants use automated tunnel washing systems and large-scale water and energy conservation equipment.

Ecotex serves healthcare systems across Canada and the United States, counting hundreds of hospital locations among its customers. Its client base includes acute-care hospitals, long-term care facilities, and other medical institutions that rely on certified, sustainable linen programs.

The company emphasizes that its family ownership allows rapid decision-making, long-term reinvestment, and direct issue resolution. Ecotex differentiates itself through its Smarter Linen Solutions™ framework, Hygienically Clean and Clean Green certifications, HLAC accreditation, and a stated goal of turning customers into “raving fans” through attentive service and technical excellence.

name: Edesia Nutrition
old_description: We produce an entire range of therapeutic foods to treat and prevent malnutrition. Since 2010, Edesia has shipped to 65 countries with global partners.
about:
Edesia Nutrition was founded in 2010 in North Kingstown, Rhode Island, by Navyn Salem after she saw a 60 Minutes segment on Plumpy'Nut and recognized the potential to expand its reach. The company operates as a manufacturer of therapeutic foods from its Rhode Island facility, driven by a mission to end malnutrition.

The company produces a full range of ready-to-use therapeutic and supplementary foods, including Plumpy'Nut, at a scale of up to 88 million pounds annually. Its factory sources ingredients from 17 U.S. states and handles formulation, packaging, and quality control for products designed to treat and prevent malnutrition.

Edesia serves humanitarian aid organizations, governments, and global health partners, delivering to communities in over 65 countries facing crises. Its logistics arm coordinates customized shipments by land, air, and sea, while its coalition-building approach tailors nutritional solutions to specific emergencies.

The organization distinguishes itself through an integrated model that combines domestic manufacturing with last-mile delivery, a $9 million innovation fund launched in 2024 supporting research in 13 countries, and advocacy efforts aimed at scaling nutrition programs worldwide.
